propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is built assuming Anthropic's API shape with hardcoded provider name matching on 'anthropic' prefix, blocking support for AWS Bedrock and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints
documentation claims REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL and REBAR_LLM_API_KEY are functional, but _pai_check_config() actively rejects them, making the documented interface non-operational

Bedrock-hosted Claude cannot use the existing retrying transport, prompt caching, or structured output support due to lack of a native builder and Bedrock's different transport (botocore/boto3 instead of httpx)
the signed verdict sidecar records only a model string without provider identity or tier, preventing attestation consumers from distinguishing first-class from best-effort LLM calls

retry and timeout configuration (llm_retry_max_attempts, llm_retry_max_wait_s, timeout_s) does not propagate to Bedrock, leaving production (which runs on Bedrock) with no configured retry or timeout guarantees
